description:
## Goal

Scenario-auditor rule that verifies every scenario's CLI implements `introspect` and returns a schema-valid command tree. Since cli-core enforces this centrally, the rule should pass for free for any scenario on the current cli-core version.

## Expected Work

- Rule in `scenarios/scenario-auditor/api/rules/` that invokes `<scenario-cli> introspect` and validates the output.
- Informative failure messages when a scenario is on an outdated cli-core version.

## Acceptance

- Rule passes for every scenario once cli-core ships introspect.
- Produces actionable failure for any scenario still on a pre-introspect cli-core.
name: cli-conversational-auditor-rule
title: Add scenario-auditor rule that every CLI responds to `introspect`
